description: Add elements to a freeform canvas, one call per drawing step. Each element is an excalidraw-style object ({type, x, y, width?, height?, text?, label?, start?, end?, ...}); skeleton shorthand is accepted and converted at render time. Elements without an id get a stable generated one. The open console canvas streams every call, so shapes appear as they are added. Returns the assigned ids and the new element count.

elements.description: Elements to append, in z-order. Objects with at least a `type` string; unknown fields pass through to the scene untouched.

id.description: Stable 8-character canvas id (format must be freeform).

element_count.description: Total elements in the scene after the add.

element_ids.description: Assigned element ids, in the order the elements were given.

id.description: The canvas the elements were added to.
